annotations.title: Pump price estimate for tomorrow in Poland: petrol 95 and diesel (finwire estimate from wholesale prices)

description: Use for what fuel will cost at Polish stations tomorrow (petrol 95, diesel) and how wholesale prices pass into pump prices. For the legally set maximum price and crude oil, use get_fuel_prices; for prices in other EU countries, use get_eu_fuel_prices. finwire estimate of the average pump price of petrol 95 and diesel in Poland for the next day (finwire_hurtcast_pb95, finwire_hurtcast_diesel): wholesale price of the last days plus the typical station margin measured on European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin prices, plus VAT, not above the maximum price of the Minister of Energy while it applies. Each estimate has its date, VAT rate, maximum price and backtest accuracy (mean absolute error per litre over up to 104 weeks, share of weeks within 10 groszy). It is a prediction of the national average, not the price at a given station. For the legally set maximum price, use get_fuel_prices; for prices in other EU countries, use get_eu_fuel_prices.

weeks.description: Number of recent backtest weeks (estimate vs station average) in the summary, default 4.
